Name: Guarana Crops (that make you run)
Author: Dionaeam
Description:
Are you tired of starting the game all over again and feeling like a slug??? 
Are you a huge fan of Guarana Soda??? Or Guarana Syrup??

This mod (so far) adds seeds that you can buy at Pierre's Shop (not sold at Joja Market). They are available at Spring and Summer, when you can plant them. It has a mechanic similar to Ancient Fruit, taking 14 days to mature and then giving more fruits once a week. If you're lucky you can harvest more than one fruit at once. 

Why is it special (if not only for the taste), when you eat it you get a little speed boost just like coffee, but it lasts longer. The seeds are expensive, though.

For now, you can make Jelly, Wine or Dehydrated Guarana. That might change once I find a way to turn it into Soda or Syrup.

I have extensive plans for developing this mod, but I'm still working on it. 

P.s. I'm not sure if the crop is plantable on vases, but I think they are (but you need to water it, same as yellow starfruit).

Ah, of course, PT-BR translated!

I hope you have fun :)
